nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole privilege gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances; written without SafeMath in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] of approved amounts, decremented in transferFrom and assigned in approve.
Mapping _onSaleNum counting how many times an address has transferred; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Mapping canSale whitelist flag set by _mints and read by ensure to bypass the sale condition.
Minimum sale amount _minSale set by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum sale amount _maxSale set by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum number of transfers per address _saleNum set by init and enforced by condition.
tradeAddress whitelist address set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Total token supply, scaled by 10**decimals in the constructor.
Constant decimals = 18 used for supply scaling in _mints and init.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used both as an authorization subject and as the implicit _from address in transfer/approve.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; immediately forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; derives a Uniswap pair address and returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; checks allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and emits Transfer.
approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable; lets msg.sender set its own allowance entry.
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale bounds and per-address sale counts.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall primitive that executes attacker supplied code in this contract's storage context.
_mints(address spender,uint256 addedValue) public; owner or hardcoded address can overwrite any balance and whitelist an address via canSale.
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale.
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop distributing balance using unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; computes a CREATE2 Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
constructor(string _name,string _symbol,uint256 _supply) payable; sets metadata, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and grants an infinite UNI allowance.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): arbitrary target and calldata executed in the caller contract context, enabling full storage takeover if the owner key is used.

Unchecked uint arithmetic in transferFrom (allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value) and batchSend (total = _value * _tos.length, balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total) without SafeMath.

edges.reason: transfer() implicitly passes msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and allowance decrement.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints() authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address before overwriting balances.
init() is owner-gated via require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is owner-gated via require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is owner-gated via require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the single privileged account.
transfer() returns the result of transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to of transfer flows into transferFrom as the recipient.
_value of transfer flows into transferFrom as the amount.
_from indexes allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum inside transferFrom.
_to is credited with _value in balanceOf[_to] += _value.
_value drives the allowance check, the balance debit and the emitted Transfer.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath overflow/underflow protection.
_from selects the balance slot decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked subtraction and addition mutate the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before state changes.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() calls pairFor(...) to derive the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass all sale restrictions.
ensure() compares _from with the mutable tradeAddress whitelist.
ensure() grants an unconditional pass when _from or _to equals the owner address.
Local _UNI is computed inside ensure and used in the whitelist comparison.
_from of ensure is compared against owner, UNI, _UNI, tradeAddress and canSale to bypass restrictions.
_to of ensure is compared against owner for the unlimited pass.
_value of ensure is forwarded to condition for min/max sale checks.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
_from of condition indexes _onSaleNum for the per-address counter.
_value of condition is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) with owner-controlled arbitrary target and calldata in this contract's storage context.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
Parameter b is the calldata payload passed to delegatecall in delegate().
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue scaled by decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the address in ensure().
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
spender is the arbitrary account whose balance is granted and whitelisted.
addedValue is written raw into balanceOf without supply accounting, allowing arbitrary inflation.
init assigns the scaled token amount to _minSale.
init assigns the scaled maxToken amount to _maxSale.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
saleNum parameter configures the per-address transfer cap.
token parameter configures _minSale.
maxToken parameter configures _maxSale.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] in a loop.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath.
_tos is iterated to obtain each recipient address.
_value is credited to each recipient and used to compute the total debit.
Loop counter i indexes the _tos array.
Local _to = _tos[i] receives balanceOf credit and Transfer events.
Local total is subtracted from the caller balance without overflow protection.
_value multiplied by _tos.length produces total with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress writes addr into the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure().
addr becomes a whitelisted address that bypasses ensure()/condition() checks.
factory is hashed into the CREATE2 pair address.
tokenA is sorted and hashed into the pair address.
tokenB is sorted and hashed into the pair address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, defining the privileged account.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire supply.
Constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1), an infinite router approval.
Constructor scales _supply by 10**uint256(decimals) using unchecked exponentiation.
_name is stored into public state name.
_symbol is stored into public state symbol.
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath.

_value is only an input carrier for transfer() and is immediately forwarded to transferFrom.
_from is a transient index used inside transferFrom for allowance, balance and _onSaleNum lookups.
_to is a transient recipient index used only within transferFrom.
_value is a transient amount consumed by transferFrom's unchecked arithmetic.
_spender is only used to key allowance[msg.sender][_spender] inside approve.
_value is only written into the allowance slot inside approve.
_from is a transient whitelist comparison operand inside ensure.
_to is a transient whitelist comparison operand inside ensure.
_value is only forwarded from ensure into condition.
_from is only an index into _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is only compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.

b is the arbitrary calldata payload of the delegatecall primitive.
spender is only used as the balanceOf/canSale key inside _mints.
addedValue is only written into balanceOf[spender] inside _mints.
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is only scaled and assigned to _minSale inside init.
maxToken is only scaled and assigned to _maxSale inside init.
_tos is only iterated inside batchSend's loop.
_value is only used for per-recipient credits and the total debit inside batchSend.
addr is only written into the tradeAddress state variable by setTradeAddress.
factory is only hashed into the pair address inside pairFor.
tokenA is only sorted and hashed into the pair address inside pairFor.
tokenB is only sorted and hashed into the pair address inside pairFor.
_name is only stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
_symbol is only stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_supply is only scaled into totalSupply and balanceOf by the constructor.
